plain_definition: HKMA's name for a potential digital form of the Hong Kong dollar issued by the monetary authority itself, distinct from money held in a commercial bank account or a privately issued stablecoin. HKMA has explored e-HKD in stages, most recently through the e-HKD Pilot Programme, completed in October 2025; it has said its near-term focus for e-HKD is on wholesale payments and support for Hong Kong's tokenisation ecosystem (an effort it brands e-HKD+), rather than on a retail e-HKD available directly to the public.
formal_definition: No decision to issue e-HKD has been made; it remains a research and pilot initiative of HKMA rather than legal tender. A retail e-HKD, if HKMA ultimately proceeded with one, would be a form of central bank digital currency (CBDC).
